strength.hint: At least 10 characters. Avoid common passwords, sequences and your username; a passphrase of 16+ characters is safer.

weak.tooShort: Password must be at least 10 characters.
weak.tooLong: Password can be at most 72 bytes (about 24 CJK characters).
weak.common: This is a common weak password. Choose one that is harder to guess.
weak.username: Password must not contain the username.
weak.product: Password must not contain a product name such as gately.
weak.sequence: Password is a sequence of characters (such as 123456, abcdef, qwerty). Choose another one.
weak.repeat: Password is made of repeated characters or fragments. Choose another one.
weak.simple: Password uses only one type of character. Mix letters, digits or symbols, or use a passphrase of 16+ characters.
weak.control: Password must not contain line breaks or control characters.

force.descDefault: The administrator still uses the public default password, so anyone who knows it can sign in. Change it to continue.
force.descWeak: The current password is too weak and easy to brute-force. Change it to continue.
force.required: Enter the current and new password
force.mismatch: The new passwords do not match
force.doneRelogin: Password changed. Please sign in again with the new password.

banner.warn: Console security score is {score}. Hardening recommended: {items}.

center.title: Console security score
center.desc: Checks how secure the console sign-in is under the current configuration. Resolve the flagged issues.
center.exposed: The console may be exposed to the internet
center.notExposed: The console is limited to the LAN or this machine

password.title: Administrator password
password.ok: Password strength is sufficient, or password login is turned off.
password.default: Still using the public default password; anyone can sign in.
password.weak: Password is too weak and easy to brute-force.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.ok: Two-step verification or Passkey is enabled.
twoFactor.warn: Neither two-step verification nor Passkey is enabled, so a leaked or brute-forced password cannot be stopped from signing in.

entry.title: Secure entry
entry.ok: A secure entry is set, or the console is limited to the LAN.
entry.warn: No secure entry is set, so scanners can find the sign-in page directly.

https.title: HTTPS encryption
https.ok: Sign-in traffic is encrypted, or the console is not exposed to the internet.
https.warn: Currently accessed over plain HTTP; passwords and sessions travel unencrypted over the network.

lockout.title: Failed-login lockout
lockout.warn: The failure limit is too high or the lockout too short, making brute force cheap.

globalLimit.title: Unfamiliar-address failure budget
globalLimit.ok: Enabled: sign-ins from unfamiliar addresses are limited automatically when brute force is spread across many of them.
globalLimit.warn: Disabled: brute force spread across many addresses is not limited as a whole.

username.title: Administrator username
username.ok: The username is not a common default name.
username.warn: The username is a common default name (such as admin). Use one that is hard to guess.

limit.label: Unfamiliar-address failure budget
limit.help: Within 10 minutes, once the total failed sign-ins from all addresses that have never signed in successfully reach this count, sign-ins from unfamiliar addresses are temporarily limited; addresses that have signed in successfully are unaffected. Defends against brute force spread across many addresses. Default is 20.

passwordLogin.title: Turn off password login
passwordLogin.desc: Once off, the administrator account can only sign in with a Passkey or a third-party login, so the password can no longer be brute-forced. Read-only accounts are unaffected.
passwordLogin.needPasskey: Register a Passkey before turning off password login.
passwordLogin.lastPasskey: Password login is off; the last Passkey cannot be deleted
passwordLogin.confirmOff: Once off, the administrator account cannot sign in with a password. If you lose all Passkeys, run gately reset-password on the server to turn it back on. Enter the current password to confirm.
passwordLogin.confirmOn: Once back on, the administrator account can sign in with a password again. Enter the current password to confirm.
